## Purpose
The main API module. It re-exports the types and holds the typed endpoint groups for health, conversations, chat, orchestration, uploads, tools, MCP, libraries, connectors, ontology, workflows, executions and RAG.

## Responsibilities
- **Re-exports** the types from `@/types`, `remoteServers`, `knowledge`, `processes`, `settings` and `observability`.
- **`healthApi.get`:** `GET /health`.
- **`conversationsApi`:** list, get, history and remove (`/api/conversations…`).
- **Chat and orchestration:**
  - `chatApi.completions`: `POST /api/chat/completions`;
  - `orchestratorApi.run`: `POST /api/orchestrate`.
- **Uploads:**
  - `uploadAttachment(file)`: `POST /api/uploads/file` (multipart);
  - `inputSupportApi.get`: `GET /api/uploads/support`;
  - `uploadImage`: `POST /api/uploads/image`.
- **`toolsApi`:** list, get, pending, synthesize, approve, reject, update (PUT), versions, activate, remove/delete, test, byHash, publishMcp (`/api/tools…`).
- **`mcpApi`:** servers, addServer, removeServer, disconnect, reconnect, tools, execute and healthCheck (`/api/mcp…`).
- **`librariesApi`:** list, create, update, remove, documents, upload (multipart), addWebpage and removeDocument (`/api/libraries…`).
- **`connectorsApi`:** list, create, get, update, remove, tools, authentication, authUrl, credentials and deleteCredentials (`/api/connectors…`).
- **`ontologyApi`:**
  - overview, tiers;
  - schemes and concepts (CRUD), descendants, usage;
  - annotations (list, for a subject, set, add one, delete one, clear);
  - graph and scopeGraph;
  - knowledge (list, search, create, delete), agentKnowledge;
  - `attachKnowledgeTool` → `POST /api/rag/agents/sync`.
- **`workflowsApi`:**
  - list, get, create, update, validate;
  - prerequisites, rebuildActivity;
  - scriptPreview, fixFanOuts, wireArguments, script;
  - register / exportToMistral → `POST /api/workflows/{name}/export`;
  - getDeploymentManifest, and `deploymentPackageUrl(name)` → `/api/workflows/{name}/deployment/package`;
  - uploadInputDocument and deleteInputDocument (`/inputs/{field}/documents`);
  - builder catalog, archive and unarchive, remove;
  - executionsFor and metrics.
- **`executionsApi`:**
  - list, cancelMany, terminateMany, get, steps, history;
  - the trace (info, summary, events, otel) and logs;
  - signal, query, update, cancel, terminate and reset (`/api/workflows/executions/{id}/…`).
- **`ragApi`:**
  - status;
  - library documents (list, upload), extract, deleteDocument;
  - library rules, draft (get and save), commit;
  - graph, search, optimizer preview;
  - timelines and timeline, `timelineStreamUrl`;
  - library ontology (propose, approve, delete draft, get, update) and domains (get, set, classify);
  - unified graph, syncTaxonomy and syncAgents.

## Key elements
The `*Api` objects listed above.

## Control flow
Called by components through React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
HTTP only.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Uses:** `client.ts`.
- **Mirrors the backend's `app/routes/*.py`.**

## Error handling and edge cases
- Errors propagate through axios. 200 bodies with `{error}` throw (`unwrap`).

## Nuances and gotchas
- **The input-document upload resolves only after Mistral has read the document,** so it can take a long time.
- **`deploymentPackageUrl` is a URL builder, not a request.** Downloads go through the browser.

## How to rebuild this file
One object per area with these methods and paths. The backend route list is the source of truth.

## Tests
None.
